prompt:
Original premium painterly 2D tactical-fantasy RPG VFX ONLY sprite concept sheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Absolutely no background, characters, costume, held weapons, UI, numbers, lettering, labels, grid or panel borders. Exactly THREE COLUMNS by FOUR EQUALLY SPACED ROWS, twelve separate isolated effects with generous completely transparent gutters. Landscape sheet. Read each row left to right: PREPARATION small gathered glint, PEAK one clear impact shape, DISSOLUTION delicate wispy afterglow/chaff. Medium controlled weight, tiny bright ivory cores, colored edges, soft transparent feathered trails, restrained stone splinters. Designed to be legible when each cell is reduced to 50–90px wide in a 390px portrait RPG. Actors/boots/HP must remain readable; mostly negative space, no opaque smoke, bloom cloud or giant filled area, no heavy boulders. All ground shapes shallow in perspective, no full perfect rings. Do not paint stuns, chains, cages, cancellation stamps or spell symbols that imply an unearned status. One impact per cell, not multiple repeated strikes.
ROW 1 BASH, shield collision: ivory/gold with a restrained blue rim. Preparation a compact tilted ivory wedge glint. Peak a solid-feeling SHORT blunt crescent impact blade fanning out horizontally at body contact, clear forward pressure, a few short radiating angular fragments and feathered streaks trailing backward, no shield icon, no dome, no barrier. Fade fractured ivory/gold slivers with two airy blue wisps.
ROW 2 SLAM, precise rune hammer impact: warm bronze/amber with a faint violet accent. Preparation a slender vertical descending ember seam with a tiny downward wedge. Peak ONE narrow top-to-bottom amber impact shaft hitting a small angular ground nick, two short asymmetrical hooked rune-like slivers, minimal low stone chips, not an explosion or circular shockwave. Fade two vertically falling bronze feather-wisps and a dim jagged ground thread. Local single-target force, narrow silhouette.
ROW 3 QUAKE, earthshaker: pale amber and muted copper. Preparation two small low ground-point glints. Peak a shallow wide FAN of five tapering fractured luminous ground veins radiating from one little low contact point, a few tiny lifted stone flakes at the outer tips, deliberate negative space between fissures, no circle. Afterglow low outward dissolving amber dust threads following the fissure directions. Impact is localized per actual recipient; no global field-covering terrain.
ROW 4 TREMOR, stone lure: jade/cyan and pale silver with subdued teal. Preparation three faint short oblique parallel ground ribs. Peak a shallow asymmetric comb of converging soft ground ripples and three slanted pale stone-fin slivers, leaning LEFT toward the caster side, not roots or a trap, no cage, no paralysis symbols, no armorbreak, no power-down icon. Fade long thin curved jade/silver feathery ribbons drifting left, elegant airy trailing ends, soft but clearly directed. Visually different from row3 jagged fracture fan.
Cohesive hand-painted game art, precise slim edges and uneven organic texture, light translucent volume. Preserve a compact peak shape, no extra objects and strictly keep every effect inside its own cell.
